en.name: High Priest
en.ability: Each day, publicly choose a unique living player to bless: if a majority of players agree, tomorrow they may learn a statement. Tonight, choose if it’s true.

revisions.v1: Each day, publicly choose a unique living player to bless: if a majority of players agree, tomorrow they may learn a statement. Tonight, choose if it’s true.

en.flavor: "Deny everything, burn the records, say these are lies, anything not to recognise that gods look after our human affairs." - Marcus Tullius Cicero 106 B.C. – 43 B.C.
en.otherNightReminder: If the High Priest successfully blessed a player today, wake the High Priest. The High Priest chooses whether the statement is true tomorrow with a hand signal (true "thumbs up", false "thumbs down").

zh.name: 大祭司
zh.ability: 每个白天，你可以公开选择一名之前未选择过的玩家去祝福：如果多数玩家同意，他可以在明天得知一条信息。当晚，你要选择这条信息是否正确。

revisions.v1: 每个白天，你可以公开选择一名之前未选择过的玩家去祝福：如果多数玩家同意，他可以在明天得知一条信息。当晚，你要选择这条信息是否正确。

zh.flavor: ‘否认一切，烧毁记录，宣称这些都是谎言，任何东西都无法认识到神在照顾我们人类的事务。’-马尔库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗 前106-前43
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果今天白天一名玩家被祝福，唤醒大祭司，让他选择点头或摇头来决定信息是否正确。
